title: 第11章 隐身救人第12章 无端诬告
lines: 楚峰看见远处的天空，有着一道身影正在不停的朝着下方的密林搜索着。
同时他嘴里还不停的嘟囔着。
“秦诗瑶那小娘皮中了毒，跑不远，应该就在这附近了。”
吴杰意气风发。
这两日，他可谓是运气爆棚。
昨日，意外碰见了一个美人，得到了一枚碎片。
而夏侯瑜的美貌也勾起了他的欲望。
于是，他便暗中找到了正在附近历练的浩阳宗弟子秦诗瑶，并趁机给她下了毒，想要好好享受一番。
却不料最后被秦诗瑶给逃走了。
他这才追了过来。
看着远处空中那一道急速靠近的身影，楚峰眼中闪过一丝危险气息。
他可没有忘记一天前的晚上，被那一位老者一掌拍下的情形。
如果不是葫灵保护，恐怕自己早就死去了。
而葫灵因此陷入了沉睡之中。
“哼，既然是云天宗的人，那说不得就要插上手了。
而且，他身上竟然有一枚碎片！”
这一刻楚峰决定救那女子了。
同时，还想着如何从那少年手中夺取碎片。
他悄悄的潜入到女子身边，然后将她扶起，在峡谷之中寻找了一处隐秘山洞。
等吴杰靠近的时候，楚峰便将体内的造化之力覆盖在他和女子身上。
随后两人便渐渐的隐身了。
“真是奇了怪了，那小娘皮到底藏哪去了？”
吴杰在峡谷上空来回搜索，都只发现了那一滩黑色血液。
他多次从山洞前走过，却没有发现两人。
“可恶，没想到让秦诗瑶那个小娘皮逃走了！”
气急败坏之下，吴杰在峡谷之中乱发泄了一通，随后腾空而起，飞向了远处。
而就在这时，女子睫毛微动，随后缓缓睁开了眼睛。
女子刚说出口，就被楚峰捂住了嘴巴。
“别说话，他还没有走远！”
楚峰捂住秦诗瑶的嘴巴，眼睛紧盯着不远处的天空。
等到吴杰的身影彻底消失后，他这才松开了手掌。
“你松开手！”
秦诗瑶满脸通红。
此刻，楚峰虽然松开了捂住她嘴巴的手，但是另外一只手却依旧挽在她的腰间。
如果不是因为自己中毒了，身体乏力，恐怕早就将楚峰暴打一顿。
“哦，抱歉，我不是故意的！”
楚峰连忙松开手。
两人也从隐身状态之中解除。
秦诗瑶满脸通红，丝毫没有注意到刚才自己隐身了。
“刚才，多谢了！”
content_en:
Chu Feng saw a figure in the distant sky, searching the dense forest below.
At the same time, he kept mumbling.
"Qin Shiyao's little girl's skin was poisoned and she can't run far. She should be nearby."
Wu Jie was in high spirits.
In the past two days, he has been extremely lucky.
Yesterday, I accidentally met a beauty and got a fragment.
And Xia Houyu's beauty also aroused his desire.
So, he secretly found Qin Shiyao, a disciple of the Haoyang Sect who was training nearby, and took the opportunity to poison her, hoping to enjoy it.
Unexpectedly, Qin Shiyao escaped in the end.
Only then did he catch up.
Looking at the rapidly approaching figure in the distance, a dangerous aura flashed in Chu Feng's eyes.
He had not forgotten how he was slapped by that old man the night before.
If it weren't for the protection of Hu Ling, I might have died long ago.
And Hu Ling fell into a deep sleep.
"Humph, since you are from the Yuntian Sect, you have to get involved at any time.
Moreover, he actually had a fragment on his body! "
At this moment Chu Feng decided to save the woman.
At the same time, he was still thinking about how to seize the fragments from the young man.
He quietly sneaked up to the woman, then lifted her up and found a hidden cave in the canyon.
When Wu Jie got closer, Chu Feng covered him and the woman with the power of creation in his body.
Then the two of them gradually became invisible.
"It's really weird. Where is that little girl hiding?"
Wu Jie searched back and forth over the canyon, only to find a pool of black blood.
He passed by the cave many times but did not find the two of them.
"Damn it, I didn't expect that little bitch Qin Shiyao to escape!"
In anger, Wu Jie vented his anger in the canyon, then took off into the air and flew far away.
At this moment, the woman's eyelashes moved slightly, and then she slowly opened her eyes.
"You..."
As soon as the woman spoke, Chu Feng covered her mouth.
"Stop talking, he's not gone yet!"
Chu Feng covered Qin Shiyao's mouth and stared at the sky not far away.
After Wu Jie's figure disappeared completely, he released his palm.
"Let go!"
Qin Shiyao's face turned red.
At this moment, although Chu Feng released his hand covering her mouth, his other hand was still on her waist.
If it weren't for the fact that he was poisoned and weak, he would have beaten Chu Feng long ago.
"Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to!"
Chu Feng quickly let go of his hand.
The two of them were also released from the invisibility state.
Qin Shiyao's face was flushed and she didn't even notice that she had become invisible just now.
"Just now, thank you very much!"
title_en: Chapter 11: Stealth and Saving People Chapter 12: Groundless False Accusations
